heading: Persons eligible under prior law
lead: Persons who have a status which would, under the laws in effect on December 31, 1957, entitle them to the medical services, hospital and domiciliary care, and other benefits, provided for in this chapter, but who do not meet the service requirements contained in this chapter, shall be entitled to such benefits notwithstanding failure to meet such service requirements.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1991—Pub. L. 102–83 renumbered section 627 of this title as this section. 1976—Pub. L. 94–581 substituted “1957” for “1958”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1976 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 94–581 effective Oct. 21, 1976, see section 211 of Pub. L. 94–581, set out as a note under section 111 of this title.
